name: @projexlight/sdk-capability
summary: Schema + validator + scaffolder for SDK capability manifests. Defines the JSON shape every SDK ships, lints it, and provides the scaffold CLI used to author this very manifest. The foundation of P9 — without it no AI agent can reason about what SDKs are available.

hooks.name: validateManifest
hooks.description: Parse + validate a manifest against the schema; returns structured errors per field.

hooks.name: lintManifest
hooks.description: Soft-fail lints (TBD detection, scenario-code shape, summary length, minimum scenarios).

hooks.name: diffManifests
hooks.description: Diff two manifests for breaking-change detection in CI.

hooks.name: scaffoldManifest
hooks.description: Auto-detect endpoints + events + models from the SDK source + write a starter manifest.

scenarios.title: CI gate validates every SDK PR
scenarios.when_to_use: scripts/registry-validate.mjs walks packages/* + services/* on every PR — refuses the merge if any manifest fails validation.
scenarios.expected_outcome: PR blocked until manifest validates. Authors fix at PR time, not at release time.

scenarios.title: Scaffold a starter manifest for a new SDK
scenarios.when_to_use: New SDK author runs `sdk-capability scaffold --dir packages/sdk-foo`; tool auto-detects endpoints + models + events from src/server/, src/events.ts, db/migrations/*.sql.
scenarios.example_code:
$ npx @projexlight/sdk-capability scaffold --dir packages/sdk-foo
Wrote scaffolded manifest to packages/sdk-foo/sdk-capability.json
Next: edit the placeholder fields (summary, scenarios, compliance) then validate
scenarios.expected_outcome: Starter manifest with auto-detected fields + placeholder strings for the prose parts. Author fills in + validates.

scenarios.title: Diff old vs new manifest before release
scenarios.when_to_use: Release-time CI — diff against the prior version's manifest; if any consumer-facing event is removed or a model is renamed, fail the release.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Breaking changes caught at release time. Authors either revert, bump major, or document the migration.

scenarios.title: Lint enforces ≥3 scenarios per manifest
scenarios.when_to_use: Quality bar — every SDK ships at least 3 scenarios so AI agents have enough examples to reason about it.
scenarios.example_code:
// inside lintManifest:
if (manifest.scenarios.length < 3) return { severity: 'error', message: 'minimum 3 scenarios required' };
scenarios.expected_outcome: Manifests with < 3 scenarios refused. Authors think about real use-cases.

compliance_posture.notes: Manifest is the SOC2-CC8.1 change-management artifact for SDK API surface — every documented capability traces to a versioned manifest in git.
